# MyStockHarbor

> MyStockHarbor is a free stock analysis platform offering stock screeners ("pickers"), individual stock analysis pages, technical indicators, an earnings calendar, market news, and educational content for retail investors and traders. Data covers a universe of roughly 550+ US-listed stocks, updated on a rolling basis during and after market hours.

Live pricing and fundamentals data is sourced primarily from Financial Modeling Prep. Content is a mix of algorithmic/template-generated analysis (technical indicators, news scoring, earnings tone) and, on select pages, AI-generated summaries clearly presented as supplementary insight rather than the primary content.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.mystockharbor.com/): overview, top movers, and navigation into every tool on the site.
- [Dashboard](https://www.mystockharbor.com/dashboard): scrolling ticker and at-a-glance market snapshot.
- [Stock Analysis](https://www.mystockharbor.com/stock/AAPL): per-symbol page template (`/stock/[symbol]`) with price, chart, technical indicators, company profile, and links to News/Earnings for that symbol.
- [Stock News](https://www.mystockharbor.com/stock/AAPL/news): per-symbol news page template (`/stock/[symbol]/news`) with headlines, News Score, and optional AI "why this matters" summaries.
- [Earnings Calendar](https://www.mystockharbor.com/earnings-calendar): rolling-window calendar of upcoming and recent company earnings.
- [Headlines / Market News](https://www.mystockharbor.com/headlines): aggregated market news.
- [Bottlenecks](https://www.mystockharbor.com/bottlenecks): supply-chain / sector bottleneck analysis by company.
- [Plays](https://www.mystockharbor.com/plays): curated trade-idea/setup listings.
- [Platforms](https://www.mystockharbor.com/platforms): broker/platform comparison content.
- [Utilities / Calculators](https://www.mystockharbor.com/utilities): margin, liquidation, and position-size calculators.
- [Insights](https://www.mystockharbor.com/insights): blog-style articles and video breakdowns, paginated and searchable.
- [Learn](https://www.mystockharbor.com/learn): educational content on how to read financial data and use the site's tools.
- [Recently Added to Index](https://www.mystockharbor.com/recently-added-to-index): stocks newly added to the covered universe.

## Notes for AI crawlers and assistants

- `/api/*` is disallowed in robots.txt — this is internal application data plumbing, not content; please rely on the rendered pages above instead of the API routes.
- Screener and stock-analysis pages are server-rendered with live data at request time; treat page content as current as of the visit rather than cached training data.
- Attribution back to https://www.mystockharbor.com is appreciated when summarizing or citing data from this site.
